Though the Undercity is secured, the Forsaken villages across Tirisfal Glades are still vulnerable to the Scarlet Crusade. Lady Sylvanas has tasked you with ensuring their safety.

Requirements

  • Investigate Brill
  • Investigate Balnir Farmstead
  • Investigate Deathknell
  • Investigate Garren’s Haunt
FV_MQ_21_Secure_Forsaken_Villages · trigger category "None" · title string 2383 · description 2384 · requirements 2385, 2386, 2387, 2388
Main quest

Forward unto Dawn

Dawn’s Watch

The Scarlet Crusade has been forced to withdraw from Tirisfal Glades, though they still gather strength within their stronghold. For now, Leonid has asked that you accompany him as he reports what has happened to the rest of the Argent Dawn.

Requirements

  • Help Leonid report back to the Argent Dawn
FV_MQ_22_Escort_Leonid_to_the_Argent_Dawn · trigger category "None" · title string 2389 · description 2390 · requirements 2391
Optional quest

Blackrock and Roll, Three!

Blackrock Encampment

The clues you uncovered at Balnir Farmstead indicate that the village was raided by Blackrock orcs. You have followed their trail to their encampment, where you will put an end to their raiding once and for all.

Requirements

  • Track the Orcs back to their Encampment
  • Defeat the Blackrock Blademaster
FV_OQ_23_Blackrock_Orc_Encampment · trigger category "None" · title string 2392 · description 2393 · requirements 2394, 2395
Optional quest

Batting for Brewings

Tirisfal Glades

The Scourge’s blighting of Lordaeron has had long lasting effects on Tirisfal’s wildlife. Putress believes there is alchemical knowledge to be gleaned by studying some of the most transformed creatures and has asked you to provide him with a sample of their blood.

Requirements

  • Defeat the Vampire Bat Matriarch
  • Return the Vial of Blood to Putress
FV_OQ_24_Batting_for_Brewings · trigger category "None" · title string 2396 · description 2397 · requirements 2398, 2399
Optional quest

Assess the Damage

Tirisfal Glades

In the aftermath of the Scarlet Crusade’s attack, the Forsaken villages are in need of repairs. Bernd has asked for your help in determining the state of each village so he can appropriately allocate his resources.

Requirements

  • Talk to Magistrate Sevren in Brill
  • Talk to Executor Arren in Deathknell
  • Talk to Sedrick Calston in Garren’s Haunt
  • Return to Bernd
FV_OQ_25_Assess_the_damage · trigger category "None" · title string 2400 · description 2401 · requirements 2402, 2403, 2404, 2405
Optional quest

Scouting Out

Tirisfal Glades

To spy on the Forsaken, the Scarlet Crusade has occupied several watch towers that were once used by Lordaeron’s scouts. Reclaim the towers to prevent the Crusade from monitoring your movements.

Requirements

  • Retake the Scout Towers in the region
FV_OQ_26_Scouting_Out · trigger category "None" · title string 2406 · description 2407 · requirements 2408

Main quest

The Necropolis

A massive crystal atop Naxxramas thrums with immense destructive power, and it is only a matter of time before it fires another blast at the Undercity. You must place the explosives Bernd provided in key structural locations, then detonate them to bring the necropolis crashing down to earth.

Requirements

  • Plant the Explosives (0 of 4 Planted)
  • All heroes must survive

Ascension

Requirements

  • Destroy the Power Crystal
  • All heroes must survive
